newsitem.title: USA: Valmy, Nev. 254 MW coal-fired unit seen up by wknd.
newsitem.headline: Valmy, Nev. 254 MW coal-fired unit seen up by wknd.

text.p: The 254 megawatt (MW) unit 1 at the Valmy coal-fired power plant in Nevada is unlikely to return to full power until the weekend after it was cut to half-load due to a tube leak on Tuesday, sources familiar with the plant's operations said Wednesday.
The Valmy unit, which had just returned to service Monday after other repairs, will be taken completely off line after peak demand hours Wednesday night, they said.
The plant's other 267 MW unit was said to be operating normally.
The Valmy plant is owned by Idaho Power Co and Sierra Pacific Power Co.
